representation_binding.rule: Every R7.5.4 candidate must use exactly the durable candidate selected by R7.5.3. No action result may be generated before validation/R7_5_3_REPRESENTATION_ABLATION_RESULT.json exists and passes.

max_reason: Maximum no-limit commitment is represented once as exact ALL_IN; historical Crusher Max is not a second neural label for the same chip commitment.

sizing_semantics.fraction_formula: call_target + ceil(pot_after_call * fraction), then exact legal clamp

state_local_exact_action_deduplication.allin_priority: If a nominal fractional raise reaches the exact all-in commitment and ALL_IN is active, suppress the fractional alias and retain ALL_IN.
state_local_exact_action_deduplication.minimum_priority: If MIN_RAISE is active and a candidate resolves exactly to minimum legal raise-to, retain MIN_RAISE over fractional aliases.
state_local_exact_action_deduplication.fractional_collision_rule: Among fractional primitives resolving to the same exact non-minimum, non-all-in raise target, retain the primitive whose unclamped raw target is closest to the realized target; exact ties use smaller nominal fraction.

training_runtime.os: Ubuntu 24.04 or physically calibrated Ryzen runtime with separately recorded environment identity

root_escalation.rule: Run every structurally valid candidate at 160. Reapply the frozen selection/equivalence rules. If more than one eligible candidate remains, rerun only survivors plus required controls/referee fresh at 320 using the same frozen seeds. If still ambiguous, rerun survivors plus controls/referee fresh at 640. No threshold or candidate change is allowed between levels.

seed_derivation.formula: first positive 31 bits of SHA256('SpinCore|R7.5.4|<phase>|<index>|' + anchor)

unchanged_learning_quality_gates.rule: These are hard eligibility gates, recomputed numerically by the aggregator. They are not relative ranking metrics.

dense_referee_action_omission_metric.referee: PF_DENSE_REFERENCE for R7.5.4A; for R7.5.4B use the union of all active preflop primitives with the selected R7.5.4A postflop set.
dense_referee_action_omission_metric.continuation_policy: frozen referee AveragePolicy at the same root level and training seed
dense_referee_action_omission_metric.state_source: referee traversal with independent paired evaluation seeds; exact same state identities for every candidate
dense_referee_action_omission_metric.q_evaluation: For each heldout state evaluate every unique exact referee action using exact child state and partial-exact continuation under the frozen referee policy. Candidate omission loss is max referee-action Q minus max Q among exact actions available to the candidate in that state.
dense_referee_action_omission_metric.primary_statistic: weighted mean positive omission loss in ICM payout-delta units

crossplay_metric.reference_policy: referee policy at same root level
crossplay_metric.hu: candidate versus referee in both seat assignments on common exact deals
crossplay_metric.three_handed: candidate occupies each of three seats against two referee policies; rotate candidate through all seats on common exact deals
crossplay_metric.primary_statistic: paired mean candidate ICM delta relative to referee baseline across seat rotations

selection_cascade_each_root_level.rule: discard failures; referee may remain as diagnostic even though ineligible to win

selection_cascade_each_root_level.equivalence: A candidate is materially worse than the current best only when mean difference > 0.001 ICM AND paired 95% CI lower bound for the difference is > 0. Otherwise it remains equivalent.

selection_cascade_each_root_level.metric: worst-domain paired crossplay ICM result versus referee
selection_cascade_each_root_level.equivalence: A candidate is materially worse than the current best only when best-minus-candidate mean > 0.001 ICM AND paired 95% CI lower bound for that difference is > 0. Otherwise it remains equivalent.

selection_cascade_each_root_level.rule_postflop: retain PF0_CONTROL_33_75_AI if still tied; otherwise lexical candidate id
selection_cascade_each_root_level.rule_preflop: retain PR0_CONTROL_MIN_AI if still tied; otherwise lexical candidate id

escalation_rule.if_single_candidate_after_cascade: select at current level if level >= 320; a 160-root result can prune but cannot be the final production selection
escalation_rule.if_multiple_candidates_after_640: apply full cascade including cost and conservative fallback

r7_5_4_pass_condition: Both R7.5.4A and R7.5.4B have durable selected candidates, structural gates pass, all selected-candidate learning-quality gates pass at >=320 roots/seed, evaluation evidence is complete, and no precommitted rule changed after outputs.
notes: Fit quality is eligibility evidence, not the primary strategic ranking criterion.
The dense reference is a referee/coverage upper reference and is not automatically production-eligible.
A larger action tree must demonstrate material strategic gain rather than winning by branch count.
Exact realized action sizes remain in public history for every candidate.
No R7.5.4 result can set READY FOR TABLES true.
